notes.title: 70% OFF - Steam Spring Sale
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/5hZR8rN/capsule-main-EN.png[/img]
[h1]The Steam Spring Sale is now on![/h1]

The days are getting longer, and the flowers are starting to bloom. Which means it must be Steam Spring Sale time!

We are offering our games with our deepest discounts yet!
You can pick up Future Mirror for [b]70% off[/b] right now, until March 21st.

Discover the truth behind the mystery of your friend's death, and try to save her life in this time-travelling Japanese indie adventure game!

notes.title: Future Mirror is Available NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42502842/5a21e3df4e4293a89569cfde800fa797e32e9b1b.png[/img]
[h1]Future Mirror has now been released and is available in the Steam Store![/h1]

Thank you to everyone who has shown the developer satsuki_no_yume and us here at LocaGames support and encouragement leading up to release!

We're so happy that everyone can finally enjoy this indie game gem straight out of Japan in English for the first time. We hope you enjoy playing and look forward to seeing your comments and reviews!

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

notes.title: “Future Mirror” will release on Steam November 1st 2022.
notes.content:
English version of popular Japanese indie game “Future Mirror” will release on Steam November 1st 2022.

Mystery x fantasy x adventure game “Future Mirror” by Japanese indie game developer  Satsuki no Yume will be released in English via publisher LocaGames, November 1st 2022.
“Future Mirror” (Japanese title “Mirai Kagami”) was released in Japan earlier this year and has gone on to earn high praise with Japanese gamers with its engaging characters and gripping storyline.

Japanese players had this to say about the game;
"It's a fun game that makes me want to play it again and again.”
“I couldn't stop playing the game because I was so excited to see what happened next.”
“The story and characters are great.”
"I enjoyed the comical and fast-paced dialogue.”

notes.title: The demo for Future Mirror is now available
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the demo for Future Mirror is now available on Steam!
Check out a brief glimpse into the story, and experience the mystery for yourself.

We’re super happy to be publishing this game and we can’t wait for you to play it!
